title: country-list-js country record
description: One file per country under countries/, named <ISO2>.json. This is the source of truth; everything under data/ is generated from it.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Must match the filename.

iso_numeric.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code, zero padded. Absent for XK, which is user-assigned and has none.

name.description: Common short name in English, as the country spells it. The current name where a country has been renamed; the former name goes in name-aliases.json.

native_name.description: Endonym in the country's own language, where it differs from name. Several official languages are separated by ' / '.

demonym.description: What a person from this country is called in English.

region.description: UN M49 geographic region: the intermediate region where the scheme has one, otherwise the sub-region. Antarctica for AQ.

capital.description: Capital city, spelled as it is in English with its diacritics. Absent for territories that have none.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Must be defined in reference/currencies.json. Absent for Antarctica, which has no currency.

dialing_code.description: ITU-T E.164 country calling code, digits only, without the plus. A string, never a number: merging 247 unquoted made require() itself throw. Absent for territories with no telephone service.

area_codes.description: Where the calling code is shared, the area codes that belong to this territory within it: ['268'] for Antigua under 1, ['1534'] for Jersey under 44. Only with dialing_code.

languages.description: Languages with official status for the whole country: ISO 639-1 codes, or ISO 639-3 where the language has no two-letter code.

tld.description: Country code top-level domains delegated in the IANA root zone, each with a leading dot, including internationalized ones (Kazakhstan has .қаз).

timezones.description: IANA time zone identifiers, from the tz database. Absent for uninhabited territories.

borders.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of neighbours. The relation is symmetric: if A borders B then B borders A.

provinces.description: First-tier political subdivisions. Omit the key entirely rather than using an empty array.

code.description: Local subdivision code, null where the country has none.

region.description: Parent grouping, null where the country has none above this tier.

alias.description: Alternative names. Always a list or null -- never a bare string.
